title: Require an exact allowlisted external embed origin
preconditions: A separate fresh Saga can author external prototypes with distinct IDs for each attempt.

steps.action: Create an external link and exact-allowlist embed; separately attempt an embed with another origin and one without an allowlist.
steps.expected_result: The external link and exact-origin embed are valid; mismatched and missing allowlists are rejected.

expected_result: Require an exact allowlisted external embed origin.
